plan.title: Recreate Order with Past Delivery Date

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with one invited vendor bid.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the bid is shown.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Assert that the Recreate Order window opened.
Set the requested event end-time duration.
Choose the past Delivery Date from the date picker.
Attempt to create the order and require evidence that Procol refuses the past delivery date.
